Name: Replace the iridium needle with a cute craft knife
Author: kdtea
Description:
[size=4][b]描述 Description[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8][b]将铱针替换为一只可爱的美工刀[/b]  Replaced the iridium needle with a cute craft knife sprite[/color]

[size=4][b]安装说明 Installation instructions
[/b][/size][color=#D4D4D8] [b]1. 下载模组文件（前提是您已安装 Content Patcher 和 SMAPI） 
2. 将其解压到mods文件夹中
3. 尽情享受吧！[/b][/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]1. Download the mod files (provided you have Content Patcher and SMAPI installed)
2. Extract them to your mods folder
3. Enjoy![/color]

[color=#D4D4D8][b]如何更换美工刀外观？[/b] [/color]
[b][color=#D4D4D8]在配置文件中选择美工刀皮肤。
共有4种外观：[/color][/b]
[b][color=#D4D4D8]白黑色、粉黑色、红黑色、蓝白色！[/color][/b]

[b][color=#D4D4D8]How do I change the blade on a craft knife? [/color][/b]
[color=#D4D4D8]Select the craft knife skin in the profile settings.
There are 4 designs available: white and black, pink and black, red and black, and blue and white![/color]

[size=4][b]其他说明 Additional Information[/b][/size]
[b]因为匕首绘制图层原因，匕首替换的精灵必须这么小……因此替换无限之刃的版本才是实际的原版本，在精灵上会比匕首的替换版本更长！并不是错误，可以放心使用！[/b]
Due to the way the dagger is rendered in layers, the sprite used for the dagger replacement had to be this small... Therefore, the version that replaces the Infinity Blade is actually the original version, and the sprite will appear longer than the dagger replacement version! This is not a bug, so feel free to use it!
[b]自带英语与中文翻译[/b]！
Includes English and Chinese translations!

[size=4][b]前置需求 Requirements[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Content Patcher[/color]
Smapi

[size=4][b]致谢 Shout outs[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8][b]感谢星露谷discord频道帮助我的每个人！以及鼓励我做完这个模组的朋友们[/b]。[/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]Thank you to everyone on the Stardew Valley Discord channel who helped me! And to my friends who encouraged me to finish this mod.[/color]
